sources.entry: HandyAI – Free single-purpose tools for LLM developers: a token counter and an API cost calculator across Claude, GPT, and Gemini. Runs client-side, no signup.

summary.name: HandyAI
summary.one_liner: A collection of free, single-purpose browser tools for LLM developers, including a side-by-side token counter and API cost calculator for Claude, GPT, and Gemini.
use_cases: Estimate token counts before sending prompts to Claude, GPT, or Gemini
Convert a JSON Schema into an Anthropic tool-use definition
Compare two versions of a prompt to see what changed
Fix broken JSON with an AI-suggested correction
summary.what_it_does: The site lists 10 free tools for prompt engineers and LLM developers. The headline tool counts tokens and characters/words for Claude 3.5 Sonnet, GPT-4o, Claude 3 Haiku, and Gemini 1.5 Flash, with per-call cost estimates. Other tools convert JSON Schema into an Anthropic tool-use definition, estimate monthly API costs, convert cron expressions to English and back with validation, diff two prompt versions structurally, and turn a markdown conversation into a Claude API request JSON. Several tools are labeled AI-powered: a system prompt auditor, a regex generator, a broken-JSON fixer, and a prompt template generator. The page says the tools run entirely in the browser and require no sign-up.
notable: Live side-by-side token counts and cost estimates for Claude, GPT-4o, and Gemini models
Converts JSON Schema into Anthropic tool-use definitions
Runs client-side in the browser with no sign-up
Structural diff for comparing prompt versions
caveats: Some tools are labeled AI-powered, which implies they call an AI service; the page does not say how that is provided or priced
Token counts and cost figures are estimates; the page does not state how exact they are against provider tokenizers
Model coverage shown is limited to the listed Claude, GPT-4o, and Gemini 1.5 Flash models
